title: Je'zzee Likes Spit Juice
description: Je'zzee Likes Spit Juice — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Nielsen

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to the lower branches of Frump's Misfortune and kill Divine Whisker Venomspitters to collect 20 vials of 'Spit Juice' and then return to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Nielsen

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Je'zzee Wants Whisker Metal

Zone: Frump's Misfortune

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the lower branches of Frump's Misfortune and kill Divine Whisker Venomspitters to collect 20 vials of 'Spit Juice' and then return to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

The producers have a task for you. We have a new up and coming hotshot by the name of Je'zzee Jaym'zz that's been hired for our new project called Monster Toolshed. He's given us a list of items he requires to get his first creation off the ground.

Inside of Karnage's Lot you will find some Divine Whisker Venomspitters that lumber around with a large pack on their backs. Inside that pack is what Je'zzee calls 'Spit Juice.' It's a highly volatile solution that he needs a large quantity of in order to power his new 'SOMETHING COOL'. His words, not mine. Marketing has yet to greenlight that name.

If Karnage's Lot is not your scene, you can always look for Venomspitters in Choppe's Shoppe or Je'zzee's own garage both of which can be found off of the lowest level of Frump's Misfortune. Once you wrap up this task, report back to Nielsen.

Turn-in:

My word! I've smelled things that came out the end of an Orok after an all night bean and cabbage buffet that didnt smell half as bad as that Spit Juice. Ugh! It should be called Bile Juice. Just put it in this pouch and tie the top off. I should thank you for bringing back the supplies, but I'm not too sure I can thank someone who almost lead to me lose my mutton.

Je'zzee has another request for materials that we need outsourced. One that won't leave you curled up in a fetus position inside of an outhouse hovering over a hole in the ground. If you are looking for adventure, excitement, and possibly a mention in the credits of Monster Toolshed; let me, Nielsen know. I have some work for you. Find me in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Objectives:

  • Spit Juice ×20

Client level range: 25–45
